t0101_correction: T-0101 (GitHub #34), pre-registered in docs/RE-FREEZE-2026-08-31.md Amendment 4 BEFORE the scenario config or cli.py were edited. Geometry: 20,000 merchants over 365 days, drift onsets confined to days 30-240 for every typology, split day boundaries 0-239 / 240-299 / 300-364, and an INDEPENDENT merchant-fold ratio of 60% / 15% / 25% (decoupled from the day-span proportions, which are 65.75% / 16.44% / 17.81% of 365 days). eval_module_sha256 below is byte-identical to EVAL-LOCK.json's: eval/splits.py is not edited. The independent merchant fold is assigned by a sibling function in cli.py (_merchant_fold_t0101, own salt), threaded into models/dataset.py's materialise() as an optional fold_fn parameter that defaults to None (= the old, unmodified eval.splits.merchant_fold behaviour). schemas.py is also untouched: the two additional results-row denominators (n_labelled_merchants, n_censored_merchants) required by T-0101 are sidecar JSON keys cli.py writes beside every EvalResult row, not new EvalResult fields. tests/unit/test_config.py::test_test_split_has_enough_labelled_positives_per_seed measures 59-86 labelled positives per seed at this geometry, against a >=50 floor; the same counting logic against the previous 10,000 x 360 draft (day-proportional, not independent, merchant fold) measures 16-29 per seed - RED.
unchanged_from_lock_1: The declared adoption margins (>=10% relative PR-AUC or >=3 days median TTD) and the five seeds (42-46) are carried across unchanged from EVAL-LOCK.json - not renegotiated because cycle 1 failed to meet them. Prevalence stays at the realistic ~1.5%. capacity_k and capacity_per_n_merchants (the K=50-per-10,000-merchants RATE) are unchanged; ScenarioConfig.analyst_capacity scales with the corrected population.
enforcement_note: Only eval_module_sha256 is a hard fail. The generator and scenario-config hashes are recorded as provenance and reported as drift, not enforced. verify_lock(strict=True) enforces all three once the generator is itself frozen (T-116).

declared_adoption_margins.note: from 00-charter-v2.md §2, declared before any v2 model existed. A rung is adopted only if it beats the previous rung by >=10% relative PR-AUC OR reduces median TTD by >=3 days at equal alerts-per-analyst-day, while holding p99 scoring latency <=10 ms per merchant on one CPU core.
